title: TrustBound: Payment-Epoch Completeness Reproducibility Artifact
description: Selected reproducibility artifact accompanying TrustBound: A Mechanized Note on Payment-Epoch Completeness. Contains the Lean admission and provider-contract models and checkers, eight premise-removal mutations, a finite evidence-rule diagnostic and nine tests, source-isolated reproduction runner, reference results and redacted execution evidence, and the supplementary finite flight-hotel diagnostic. The core checks 14 exported results and reproduces 2,048 records. A service supplement includes the repaired SQLite gate, 66 selected tests, and six finite service histories checked against the existing model (66 transitions, five closure instances and one undrained final state); two deliberately invalid inputs are rejected. The projection and event capture remain trusted, so this is not a universal implementation refinement. It establishes conditional model results under a trusted-service contract, not completeness of a real processor deployment or a new general closure principle. Existing tools are required; no credentials, provider calls, SDK or Docker are needed. Proposed release terms for author-owned software and accompanying documentation: MIT; author approval remains pending. Manuscript distribution terms are separate.
